## Problem / Root cause
What behavior is wrong? Show a concrete execution sequence.

## Approach
What changed or is proposed, and why is it safe?

## Verification
Tests run (include exact commands and results), and tests still needed.

## Risks / Assumptions
What is known, uncertain, or potentially unsafe? What are the delivery semantics?

## Handoff / Next steps
What should the next engineer do without an additional meeting?

## Related Issue
Closes / Relates to #
